node.title: M720 local h=5 n=32 gate replay
node.statement: The M720 full_census arithmetic reproduces the locally bounded h=5 gate fact full_census(32,5,97)=96 unordered trades, all non-toral, with 30 anchored cores.
node.attack_surface: exact standalone replay of the C(32,5) row using the same elementary-signature definitions as modal_midlarge_h7_20.py
node.falsifier: a local exact replay of full_census(32,5,97) returning a count other than 96 unordered trades
